title: Synthesis, structural characterization and molecular docking analysis of novel β-ketoiminato palladium(II) complexes with anticancer properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22352-22367
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09325B, Paper

Deeb Taher, Belal Khalil, Sara AlNaimat, Morad Mustafa, Zakariyya Ishtaiwi, Wissam Helal, Marcus Korb, Tuqa Abu Thiab, Amer Imraish, Tareq Alhindi, Ahmad Makahleh, Mohammad W. Amer, Duha H. Abdelrahman
A novel series of palladium(II) coordination complexes of the formula [Pd(CH3C(NAr)CHC(O)CH3)2] (4a–j) were synthesized by the reaction of enaminone ligands (3a–j) with [PdCl2(NCCH3)2] in a molar ratio of 2 : 1 in the presence of tBuOK.
